steps.prompt: Create exactly ONE original skill icon for dark Gothic fantasy game Heroes of Orvesk. Square 1024x1024 PNG RGBA, genuine transparent background including all openings, no painted backdrop, no floor or cast shadow, no frame, lettering, numbers, UI, watermark, or extra objects. Central compact object/gesture entirely inside canvas with 8 percent clear margin, readable at 48 pixels. Sculptural volume, rough hand-painted dry brush fantasy illustration, selective etched texture, aged materials, deep chiaroscuro, dominant charcoal and old iron with muted ivory and brown leather. Directional light from upper front LEFT. No photography, smooth 3D render, neon or cartoon. Material guidance: heavy dark metal with thin broken highlights; layered old linen with deep folds; matte worn leather. A gloved hand with two extended fingers precisely pressing against the inside of an opposing bare wrist to break its grip. Two short wrist and hand forms only, compact readable pressure-point strike gesture. No wound or blood, no glow. Conveys intelligent exhaustion rather than injury.
